questions.question: Can you tell me about your most recent position and your main responsibilities?
What programming languages and technologies are you most proficient in?
Describe a challenging technical problem you've solved recently. What was your approach?
How do you stay updated with the latest developments in technology?
Tell me about a time when you had to work with a difficult team member. How did you handle it?
What interests you about this position and our company?
Can you describe your experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies?
What's your preferred work environment - remote, hybrid, or in-office?
Tell me about a project you're particularly proud of. What was your role?
How do you prioritize tasks when you have multiple deadlines?
What are your salary expectations for this role?
When would you be available to start if we move forward?
Have you had experience mentoring junior developers?
Describe your testing philosophy and experience with different testing methodologies.
How do you handle receiving critical feedback on your work?
What's your experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP?
Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn from it?
Do you have any questions for me about the role or the company?
